chain.title: First Blade in the Kitchen
chain.desc: Flint over a stick. The starter knife: it cuts on the board, harvests wild crops whole, and slices meat into cuts that cook faster.

chain.title: Steady Hands
chain.desc: An iron ingot over a stick. Durable enough to carry through the whole cutting-board and wild-crop loop without a resupply.

chain.title: The Pot That Simmers
chain.desc: Bricks, iron, a wooden shovel and a water bucket. Set it on any heat source and it turns raw ingredients into bowls of stew unattended.

chain.title: Fast Fire
chain.desc: Iron ingots over a brick handle. It pan-fries on a heat block or, held in hand over a campfire, cooks a single item while you travel.

chain.title: Where Everything Gets Split
chain.desc: Planks over a stick. Place an item on it, strike with a knife or axe, and it yields cuts, leaves, bark and slices vanilla crafting cannot.

chain.title: Stripping the Trunk
chain.desc: Strike any log on the cutting board with an axe. It strips the log and drops bark, which also folds back into paper three at a time.

chain.title: The Hearth Proper
chain.desc: A campfire above bricks, wrapped in iron. It cooks six items at once and heats pots and skillets standing on top of it.

chain.title: Threshing the Harvest
chain.desc: Cut rice panicles or wild rice with a knife and straw falls out alongside the grain; bale it for storage or unbale it again.

chain.title: Woven from Chaff
chain.desc: Four straw in a square. This is the mod's cloth, and it becomes baskets, rugs, tatami, signs, paintings and scaffolding.

chain.title: A Line of Twisted Straw
chain.desc: Three straw in a column. Climbable, extendable downward, and the trellis that tomato vines grow along.

chain.title: The Hopper That Isn't
chain.desc: Canvas walls on a stick frame. It pulls items in from above and pushes them out its facing side without any redstone at all.

chain.title: Feeding the Ground
chain.desc: Dirt, straw and bone meal bound with tree bark or rotten flesh. Placed on the ground it slowly converts neighbouring dirt into rich soil.

chain.title: Ground That Gives Back
chain.desc: Dark crumbling earth left behind by organic compost. Crops on it grow faster, sometimes skip a stage outright, and never need tilling to stay moist.

chain.title: Paddy Work
chain.desc: Plant rice in shallow water over farmland, then cut the grown panicles with a knife for grain and straw both.

chain.title: Leaf by Leaf
chain.desc: Knife the wild cabbages found in plains for seeds. A grown cabbage cuts into leaves, and two leaves press back into a whole head.

chain.title: Pulled from the Roots
chain.desc: Cut wild onions in forests to get an onion, which replants directly with no separate seed item in between.

chain.title: Vines on the Line
chain.desc: Cut wild tomato shrubs for seeds, then grow the vines up a rope trellis for a second harvest layer above the farmland.

chain.title: Reduced and Simmered
chain.desc: Two tomatoes in the cooking pot, no bowl consumed. It is the base of pasta, fish stew and every red dish in the book.

chain.title: Kneaded
chain.desc: Three wheat with an egg, or wheat and water. It fills the forge:dough tag shared with Create, so the two mods feed each other here.

chain.title: Cut into Ribbons
chain.desc: Strike wheat dough on the cutting board with a knife. Pasta is the backbone of noodle soup and both meatball dishes.

chain.title: The Shell Before the Filling
chain.desc: Wheat around milk, or three wheat flour mixed with milk when Create is installed. Every pie in the mod starts here.

chain.title: Sunday Dinner
chain.desc: Minced beef, pasta and tomato sauce in the cooking pot; the beef comes from a knife on the cutting board, not the crafting grid.

chain.title: A Feast in a Gourd
chain.desc: Rice, onion, mushroom, potato, berries and vegetables cooked into a whole pumpkin. Placed down, it serves several players from one block.

chain.title: The Chef's Platter
chain.desc: Kelp roll slices, salmon rolls and cod rolls arranged in a bowl. The most ingredient-hungry dish in the mod and its natural capstone.

notes: Verified against FarmersDelight-1.20.1-1.3.2.jar. Every chain and collection id resolves to assets/farmersdelight/models/item/<id>.json. Recipe sources read: data/farmersdelight/recipes/*.json plus recipes/cutting/*, recipes/cooking/*, recipes/food/* and recipes/integration/*. Mechanics confirmed from the data and used in the descriptions: tree_bark comes only from recipes/cutting/<wood>_log.json (axe on the cutting board, never a grid recipe); raw_pasta comes from recipes/cutting/tag_dough.json (knife on anything in forge:dough); cabbage, onion and tomato all start by knifing wild_cabbages / wild_onions / wild_tomatoes in the world; rich_soil has NO crafting recipe at all - only loot_tables/blocks/rich_soil.json and advancements/main/get_rich_soil.json exist, because it is produced in-world by placed organic_compost, so that chain entry must be treated as an in-world objective rather than a craft. PACK CONSENSUS CONFLICT: moddb lists farmersdelight:basket (12 packs, pos 0.257) but that id DOES NOT EXIST in 1.3.2. The item was split and renamed to farmersdelight:wooden_basket (display name is still 'Basket') and farmersdelight:bamboo_basket. The chain uses farmersdelight:wooden_basket; a generator copying the raw consensus id would emit a broken task. This is version drift in the harvested packs, not a design disagreement. Consensus ordering was otherwise followed: flint_knife (pos 0.000) then iron_knife (0.071) as the chain head, and the straw / canvas / organic_compost / rice cluster (0.226-0.234) as the mid-chain farming loop. The brief's requested order (knife, cooking pot, skillet, cutting board, stove) was kept even though the recipes make cutting_board the cheapest of the five (planks + stick) and moddb places it later at 0.222 with 27 packs - the single most common Farmer's Delight quest in the corpus. Consensus items left out of the spine but verified present and safe as side quests: honey_cookie, golden_knife, diamond_knife, melon_popsicle, brown_mushroom_colony, barbecue_stick, sweet_berry_cookie, kelp_roll, cod_roll, fried_egg, chocolate_pie_slice, canvas_rug, honey_glazed_ham, cabbage_seeds, beetroot_crate. DROPPED: none - every id in this file verified.
